Resources Compilation - Videos Edition...

Here I'll compile all the free video resources you'll need to cover for your interview preparation for companies like Google, Microsoft and Amazon. Starting and going through these resources end to end would make you interview ready for almost all the major companies that are currently hiring...

➡️ DSA : 

1. Raj Vikramaditya A-Z sheet : https://lnkd.in/gzb2Vc2g
2. Vivek Gupta DP Workshop : https://lnkd.in/giqQ5PA6
3. TLE Eliminators youtube channel : https://lnkd.in/gNUszq6i
4. Ask Senior Youtube channel : https://lnkd.in/gt6yCwPA

➡️ Core CS : 

1. OS : https://lnkd.in/g6xTWcNh
2. DBMS : https://lnkd.in/g8UfAaNf
3. CN : https://lnkd.in/gaCwUvmg
4. OOPs : https://lnkd.in/gzkT-Cfv (needs further readings from other resources and blogs)

➡️ Development :

1. Namaste Javascript course : https://lnkd.in/gF-vqCxn
2. Harkirat Singh youtube channel : https://lnkd.in/g-B-iwSZ (goldmine)
3. Mosh Hamedani Youtube channel : https://lnkd.in/gjbY7TAF

➡️ System Design : 

1. Arpit Bhayani Youtube channel : https://lnkd.in/gQRCqaBG (truly one of my favourites)
2. Shrayansh Jain Youtube channel for LLD : https://lnkd.in/gAf7e-Hh
3. Keerti Purswani youtube channel for HLD & LLD : https://lnkd.in/gMrmdBen
4. Gaurav Sen Youtube channel : https://lnkd.in/g-G4tN68 (the OG resource for System Design)

These are comprehensive resources, great for folks who love following videos for tutorials. Following these wholeheartedly would allow one to be prepared for any product based companies very soon. I'll drop another post for folks, preferring written content.

Stay tuned for more such content!! ✌🏻🚀

Personal DSA Sheet : https://lnkd.in/gnH8d4Dh
